artDirection: Warm, grounded UK small-business scenes. Cream, blue and muted green accents; natural daylight; modest working environments. No robots, neon sci-fi, stock-market charts, fake testimonials or fabricated software text. Leave central safe space for real typeset overlays. People are illustrative, never represented as Promonet staff or customers. Add all logos, copy, captions and prices in the edit.

ai_ready.stillPrompt: Vertical editorial photograph for a UK small-business consulting campaign: a modest independent business owner's bright workspace, hands beside a laptop, simple cream notebook, blue pen, warm natural daylight, quiet thoughtful atmosphere. Laptop screen angled away or softly out of focus without legible text. Composition leaves upper and lower space for separately typeset messaging. Cream, cobalt blue and muted natural accents, premium but approachable documentary realism. No brand logos, text, watermarks, futuristic robots or implied client endorsement.

clips.prompt: Five-second vertical documentary-style shot in a modest UK small-business office. A business owner reviews a website on a laptop, viewed over the shoulder, natural daylight, cream and cobalt accents. Screen content softly out of focus, no legible words or identifiable brands. Gentle controlled camera push-in. A thoughtful practical mood, realistic hands and movement. No speech, captions, logos or artificial futuristic effects. Illustrative scene, not a customer testimonial.

Five-second vertical close-up of a notebook beside a laptop in the same visual style: modest UK office, cream surfaces, blue pen, soft window light. A hand places three plain blue page tabs along the notebook edge, suggesting three practical next steps. Gentle camera slide. No legible writing, logos, captions or speech. Natural realistic hand anatomy and simple restrained action.
